assertion_analysis.fails_if: Fixture is not actually parked on an incomplete manifest; validates adversarial setup.
Either of the two lease claims fails, so the congestion precondition is not established.
The earlier ready request no longer precedes the parked requests, invalidating the starvation trigger.
A promotion launches while both slots are held; these are capacity guards, not readiness coverage by themselves.
Reinstate the base loop that breaks at a full slot before reaching parked reviews: reconsidered becomes zero.
A refreshed complete review stays parked or retains its stale waiting reason.
Readiness refresh replaces a durable request identity; equality to the original input is intentional identity preservation, not evidence of the congestion repair.
The incomplete review is made ready, its reason is changed, or its timestamp is not refreshed; the clock value is independently advanced after the stored initial timestamp.
Freed capacity admits requests out of the independently specified FIFO order or the executor starts another order.
The request lacks a terminal promoted receipt after settling.
Real review promotion fails to persist either review to the isolated repository ledger, or persists extra rows; expected identities alone do not establish promotion, the independent ledger does.
An incomplete remaining review launches or changes out of WAITING after eligible requests finish.
The test fails to release its controlled executor within ten seconds; this is a bounded fixture guard.
Remove the second _pending_requests call after readiness changes: same-session requests take both slots instead of giving the other session its turn.
The remaining same-session request fails to launch next or a terminal promoted receipt is missing.
Restore the capacity-dependent loop: the hundred stored timestamps remain unchanged, yielding checked=0.
Readiness is disconnected from the independent complete/in-progress manifest state; complete is not an argument to tick or the writer.
Remove readiness_checked=True so ready pointer updates repeat their readiness reads, or omit/duplicate a parked request check.
Complete requests keep a reason or incomplete requests lose the manifest-in-progress explanation.
A full tick over the hundred parked requests takes one second or longer.
